author: Philip K. Dick
card_summary: Canonical record for Second Variety and Other Classic Stories, PKD's short-story collection. Linked to a single archive manifestation preserved in the archive.
page_summary:
Second Variety and Other Classic Stories is the canonical works-table record for PKD's short-story collection corpus item. The record links the archive's preserved manifestation of the work to the broader corpus and gives researchers a single place to follow its bibliographic and interpretive context.

The preserved archive item here is Second Variety and Other Classic Stories (1991).

The source record itself summarizes the work as follows: Second Variety and Other Classic Stories is a comprehensive collection of Philip K. Dick's short fiction, anchored by the title story "Second Variety," one of Dick's most celebrated early works about self-replicating war machines. At 499 pages, this is a substantial volume spanning much of Dick's career in the short fiction form.

The table of contents reveals an extraordinary range of stories: The Cookie Lady, Beyond the Door, Second Variety, Jon's World, The Cosmic Poachers, Progeny, Some Kinds of Life, Martians Come in Clouds, The Commuter, The World She Wanted, A Surface Raid, Project: Earth, The Trouble with Bubbles, Breakfast at Twilight, A Present for Pat, The Hood Maker, Of Withered Apples, Human Is, Adjustment Team, The Impossible Planet, Impostor, James P. Crow, Planet for Transients, Small Town, Souvenir, Survey Team, and Prominent Author, with notes.

Many of these stories have been adapted into films or television episodes. "Second Variety" became the film Screamers (1995), "Impostor" became a 2001 film, and "Adjustment Team" was adapted as The Adjustment Bureau (2011). The collection showcases Dick's mastery of the short story form and his ability to pack profound philosophical questions about identity, reality, and humanity into compact narrative structures.

The entry is most useful when tracing publication context, later commentary, or relationships to other works.
